records.name: Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce
records.description: Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce Pune is a well-regarded autonomous college affiliated with Savitribai Phule Pune University, known for its BA, BCom, and BBA programs. The college is part of the Symbiosis International University ecosystem and is recognized for its multicultural student environment and industry-oriented curriculum. It is accredited by NAAC and known for academic excellence and extracurricular activities.

records.name: Lady Shri Ram College for Women
records.description: Lady Shri Ram College for Women (LSR), University of Delhi, established in 1956, is India's most prestigious women's college, particularly renowned for its economics, English, and commerce programs. It has produced an exceptional number of civil servants, journalists, economists, and public figures. LSR is consistently ranked first among women's colleges in India and is NAAC 'A+' accredited.

records.name: St. Josephs College of Commerce
records.description: St. Joseph's College of Commerce Bangalore is an autonomous Jesuit institution established in 1882, affiliated with Bangalore University, and known for excellence in commerce and management education. It offers BCom, BBA, MBA, and MCom programs with a strong emphasis on ethical leadership, professional skills, and community engagement. The college holds NAAC 'A+' accreditation and consistently ranks among Karnataka's top commerce colleges.

records.name: Hans Raj College
records.description: Hans Raj College, University of Delhi, established in 1948, is one of Delhi's premier undergraduate colleges offering programs in sciences, commerce, and humanities. It is particularly known for its physics, chemistry, mathematics, and commerce departments, producing graduates who excel in academia, civil services, and industry. The college holds NAAC 'A+' accreditation and is consistently ranked among the top colleges in Delhi University.

records.name: Presidency College
records.description: Presidency College Chennai, established in 1840, is one of India's oldest and most distinguished government arts and science colleges, affiliated with the University of Madras. It is renowned for its programs in mathematics, physics, chemistry, economics, and humanities, having produced several eminent scientists and scholars. The college holds autonomous status and NAAC 'A+' accreditation, and is a landmark institution in South Indian education.

records.name: Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI)
records.description: The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) is a statutory professional body established under the Company Secretaries Act, 1980, that regulates the company secretary profession in India. It conducts Foundation, Executive, and Professional level examinations leading to the CS qualification, which is mandatory for certain corporate governance roles. ICSI members serve as compliance officers, corporate advisors, and governance professionals in companies across India.

records.name: Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad (IIMA)
records.description: Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad (IIMA), established in 1961, is India's most prestigious business school and consistently ranks among Asia's top management institutions. It offers flagship PGP (MBA equivalent), PGPX (executive MBA), PhD, and executive education programs. IIMA pioneered the case-study method in Indian management education and its alumni lead major corporations, governments, and startups globally.

records.name: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB)
records.description: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB), established in 1973, is one of India's top-ranked business schools, known for its strong emphasis on entrepreneurship, technology, and global business. It offers PGP, PGPEM, PGPBA, PhD, and extensive executive education programs. IIMB has one of the most active entrepreneurship cells among Indian b-schools and consistently ranks in the top tier of Asian management institutions.

records.name: Indian Institute of Management Calcutta (IIMC)
records.description: Indian Institute of Management Calcutta (IIMC), established in 1961 as India's first IIM, is one of the country's premier management schools and consistently ranks among Asia's best business schools. It offers MBA (PGDM), executive MBA, and PhD programs with particular strength in finance, operations, and strategy. IIMC alumni hold leadership positions in major global corporations, consulting firms, and financial institutions.

records.name: Faculty of Management Studies (FMS), University of Delhi
records.description: Faculty of Management Studies (FMS), University of Delhi, established in 1954, is one of India's oldest and most respected management schools, offering an MBA program at one of the most affordable fee structures among top b-schools. Its low fees combined with exceptional academic quality and placement record make it among the most competitive management programs in India. FMS alumni are prominent across banking, consulting, FMCG, and entrepreneurship.
